text: {"side":"artifact","claims":[{"text":"The event is a step between 1971.0 and 1971.04 whose amplitude of 0.97 mag is driven by non-blue emulsion points: the NON_BLUE-tagged measurements in the listed event points (dny, dnr series) show offsets near -1.2 to -1.6 mag, while the blue dnb points sit near -0.1 to -0.3 mag.","evidence_ids":["E-002","E-045","E-048","E-049","E-051","E-052","E-056","E-042","E-043","E-044","E-046","E-047","E-054"]},{"text":"The known-issue checklist flags emulsion_non_blue for 19 of 40 trigger points, so nearly half of the trigger is affected by a known non-blue emulsion problem, which is an emulsion-related artifact mechanism.","evidence_ids":["E-058"]},{"text":"The dny and dnr series carry large zero-point offsets (dnr median -1.464 mag, dny median -1.12 mag, kc -0.914), so non-blue plates from these series are systematically offset and can produce a spurious deep drop when they dominate the event epoch.","evidence_ids":["E-025","E-026","E-032"]},{"text":"The event lies in the 1960s and 1970s, where the decade scatter is large (1960 scatter 0.711, 1970 scatter 0.272) and the medians shift to about -0.22 to -0.24 mag, compared with near-zero medians earlier; the step could reflect a seam between plate-series epochs rather than a single real change.","evidence_ids":["E-012","E-013","E-014","E-057"]},{"text":"The lightcurve is not detrended and the event is not confirmed on a single plate (single_plate false, read_detrended_curve false), and a plate_edge flag is raised on one trigger point, so the step cannot yet be separated from plate-level systematics; the points shown are only 30 of 40 and rows were heavily cleaned, so the missing points could hide the counter-evidence.","evidence_ids":["E-068","E-002","E-063","E-057","E-070"]}]}
